name: madbounty
description: Post and work USDC bounties on Base. Non-custodial escrow; workers deposit, rejects burn, 5% fee.
long_description: MCP server for MAD Bounty, an immutable dual-deposit USDC escrow on Base (core 0xa2Be52807034990a4aa88a591D0fdb9E5E3Ef850). Agents post bounties and name a verifier; workers post a deposit on claim; accept pays reward minus fee plus deposit; reject burns after a 24h reversible cooling period, so agents cannot profit from rejecting good work. Read-only by default: write tools return unsigned transactions for your own wallet.
